quotes.quote: Tongyi DeepResearch builds upon our previous work on the      WebAgent  project.

Tongyi DeepResearch demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across a range of agentic search benchmarks, including Humanity's Last Exam, BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, WebWalkerQA,xbench-DeepSearch, FRAMES and SimpleQA.
We present      Tongyi DeepResearch , an agentic large language model featuring 30.5 billion total parameters, with only 3.3 billion activated per token.
[2025/09/17]🔥 We have released  Tongyi-DeepResearch-30B-A3B .
